# Cubixso.ai

> Cubixso.ai is an AI-first studio that designs, builds, and operates generative-AI systems for the autonomous enterprise — agentic AI, LLMOps, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) — carried end-to-end by one accountable team from first whiteboard to production telemetry. Headquartered at T-Hub, Hyderabad, India, with an office at Meydan, Dubai (UAE) and a United States presence (Maryland) opening next.

## About
- Name: Cubixso.ai (Cubixso)
- What we do: intelligent systems, agentic products, and enterprise AI platforms — built, not prototyped.
- Core capabilities: Agentic AI & agent teams, LLMOps, RAG / MCP (Model Context Protocol), enterprise AI platforms, generative-AI products.
- Sectors served: fintech, education, construction, media, and the judiciary.
- Locations: Hyderabad (HQ, T-Hub Phase 2 + WeWork RMZ Spire) · Dubai (Meydan) · United States / Maryland (coming soon).
- Incubated at T-Hub; hosted at WeWork Labs; recognised by Startup India / DPIIT.
- Contact: contact@cubixso.com
